prediction.reason: Semester 4 off leaves 6 teaching semesters capped at 26 MC. The industrial-experience option is at most 12 MC and does not count toward the load, so 148 MC must come from loaded modules. Almost all modules are 4 MC, 8 MC or other non-5 MC sizes, so a semester holds at most 24 MC. Only CS3216 and CS3217 are 5 MC, which adds at most 2 MC overall. So loaded MC cannot exceed 6*24+2 = 146, and the total is at most 158, below the 160 MC requirement.
